programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Roofie rape victim Darcy is barreling down a self-destructive path and only a handful of people know why.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: When cute and funny Rachel joins Peter, Danny & Derek’s MI group for their “How-To” video project, confidence is high.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Jimmy finally gets the news he’s been waiting for – he’s been accepted into NYU! But he’s got other things on his mind. He is slowly discovering that he has other options when it comes to his real dream – walking again.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: It’s Anya’s first year running the Free The Children Freedom Fast to promote education and health in Africa. She has a lot to coordinate - which would be hard enough without meddling Holly J, who’s determined to make Anya choose between her and Sav.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Marco’s world is rocked when Paige drops a bomb – her dad’s going to help her buy a condo. Ellie’s just learned she might be up for the editorship of the Core newspaper, so she’s distracted.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Mia does what she can to ensure her success. Besides, Tom is handsome and famous, so Mia thinks being with Tom to get ahead isn’t such a bad trade.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Die Boodskap: Vir Jou Lewensreis
programme.desc: 'S7/E202'. Inspirasie vir jou lewensreis vanuit Mosaek gemeente. Wat is in jou hand? Waar is ek? Roelof Nel sluit die week op 'n ho noot af met 'n gesprek rondom getuienisse.

programme.title: ontbytSAKE

programme.title: Die Toring
programme.desc: 'S1/E27'. Ryan se verlede bots met sy hede en hy moet moeilike besluite neem. Ezra speel skeidsregter tussen Anathi en Lindi. Cazz maak 'n vreemde ontdekking in Tywave se finansies.

programme.title: Die Toring
programme.desc: 'S1/E28'. Argos beraam 'n nuwe plan om van Ryan ontslae te raak, en Gabby moet besluit of sy saam speel. Stella neem 'n besluit oor Ryan. Ezra kry 'n ontstellende oproep op pad na CapeHops.

programme.title: Die Toring
programme.desc: 'S1/E29'. Gabby huiwer om 'n verdoemende verslag te teken. Ezra waag alles vir Charlie. Theo en Cazz bots oor haar toekoms met Eben, en 'n groot nederlaag dreig om alles te verander.

programme.title: Die Toring
programme.desc: 'S1/E30'. Gabby moet 'n besluit neem oor Ryan se toekoms by MPI. Cazz besef Eben se tydlyn vir hul lewe verskil van hare. Stella het 'n interessante ontmoeting met Ryan se verlede.

programme.title: Appels En Tee

programme.title: Diepe Waters

programme.title: Diepe Waters
programme.desc: 'S4/E7'. Karla verloor geduld met Sanet. Nina sien 'n ander kant van Juvan. Gys sien vir Zelda op sy perseel en konfronteer Pam daaroor.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Yimou Zhang helms this historical fantasy starring Matt Damon. An elite force of warriors must save humanity from a horde of monstrous creatures.

programme.title: Skyscraper
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson puts his body on the line in this heart-thumping action film. A security expert infiltrates a burning skyscraper when his family is taken hostage.

programme.title: Asinamali
programme.desc: Adapted from Mbongeni Ngema's Broadway production of Asinamali. On the prison yard on Robben Island, a man named Nelson Mandela told Msizi Dube Go and do it for all of us.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Jason Bateman and the gang return for more outrageous encounters. After the trio's new business is hampered by a sly investor, they come up with a misguided plan to kidnap him.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers
programme.desc: Owen Wilson and Vince Vaughn run this crazy comedy. A pair of friends and womanisers crash weddings to meet women. Things get complicated when one of them falls for a bridesmaid.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: A humourous satire about TV rating wars. A TV ratings computer malfunctions, inaccurately reporting that the audience prefers public television.

programme.title: Goodrich
programme.desc: Michael Keaton is exceptional in this bittersweet film. A father seeks help from his first daughter from his first marriage to raise his young kids after his wife checks into rehab.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman and Tommy Lee Jones star in this enjoyable action-comedy. An ex FBI Agent and ex-mob lawyer are forced to put aside their differences to fend off a potential mob hit.

programme.title: Here
programme.desc: Forrest Gump stars Tom Hanks and Robin Wright are reunited for this quirky yet emotional drama. Follow the lives of multiple generations who have lived in the same home over a century.

programme.title: Schuks! Your Country Needs You
programme.desc: Leon Schuster is back in elaborate costumes and makeup to wreak havoc across the country by testing the limits of South Africans in completely bizarre situations.

programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: Everyone's favourite ogre returns for another adventure. Newlyweds Fiona and Shrek are invited to visit Fiona's parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away.

programme.title: How To Train Your Dragon: The...
programme.desc: 'How To Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World'. Another fiery adventure in which Toothless finds another Night Fury. He and Hiccup must find a secret Dragon Utopia before an evil tyrant.

programme.title: The Fast And The Furious
programme.desc: Vin Diesel and the late Paul Walker team up for the first instalment of the popular franchise, which sees a cop go undercover to infiltrate a racing crew.

programme.title: Contraband
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg risks his life for his family in this thriller. A former smuggler is forced to pull off one more job after his brother-in-law crosses a drug boss.

programme.title: Black Site
programme.desc: A deadly cat-and-mouse game propels this action thriller. A group of top-secret military black site officers must fight to survive when a murderous detainee escapes.

programme.title: Asphalt City
programme.desc: An intense medical thriller starring Sean Penn. A young paramedic is paired with a seasoned partner on the night shift in New York, revealing a city in crisis.

programme.title: Into The Deep
programme.desc: An intense action thriller. A young woman is swept off her feet by a mysterious stranger who promises her a romantic boat trip. What follows is deceit, mistrust and violence.

programme.title: Wanderlust
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston and Paul Rudd are pushed to their limits in this comedy. When unemployment rocks a couple's lives, they try out a rural commune where free love rules.

programme.title: Marry Me
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez and Owen Wilson are thrown together in this heart-warming, crazy rom-com. A pop star marries a stranger from the audience after being betrayed by her fianc.

programme.title: Not My Type
programme.desc: An old-fashioned woman rejects every marriage proposal while waiting for the perfect match. When pressure mounts, she takes matters into her own hands to find the one.

programme.title: Spud
programme.desc: Based on the South African best-seller, this insightful and funny coming-of-age film looks at a young boy's journey into manhood that begins in the halls of boarding school.

programme.title: Spud 2: The Madness Continues
programme.desc: John Cleese is back as the razor-sharp English teacher in the follow-up to the 2010 South African hit comedy that introduced moviegoers to the coming-of-age journey of Spud.

programme.title: Spud 3: Learning To Fly
programme.desc: The third instalment of the South African tale follows a now sixteen-year-old Spud Milton (Troye Sivan) who must navigate the difficulties of being a senior at boarding school.

programme.title: Shrek The Third
programme.desc: Mike Myers and a great cast return for a third instalment to the franchise. After the king falls ill, Shrek, Fiona and friends must defend the kingdom from Prince Charming.

programme.title: Flushed Away
programme.desc: This charming animation set in England sees an uptown pet rat being flushed down the toilet and ending up in the sewers of London. He must quickly learn how to survive and adapt.

programme.title: The Ant Bully
programme.desc: A fun and colourful animated adventure with the voices of Julia Roberts and Nicholas Cage. A ten-year-old boy is shrunk down to the size of an ant after he floods a colony.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: The demigod son of Zeus must leave his peaceful life behind and become a warrior again when his father is kidnapped. He enlists the help of a warrior queen to face Zeus's captors.

programme.title: Sonic The Hedgehog 2
programme.desc: The electrifying sequel to the hit movie based on the video game. When Dr Robotnik returns to Earth with a new ally, Knuckles, Sonic and his new friend Tails must stop them.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: Ice Cube and Chris Tucker star in a comedy classic that looks at the lighter side of life in the ghetto through the eyes of two friends who have gotten themselves into trouble.

programme.title: Cellar Door
programme.desc: A chilling horror. A couple looking for a fresh start after a miscarriage are gifted the house of their dreams, with one caveat - they can never open the cellar door.
